name: CXCAS3DTCql
title: CXCA.S3.DT Act on a cervical cancer screening result (CQL)
description: The S3 decision table evaluated as REAL CQL: CXCAScreeningResultLogic (near-verbatim from the DAK) interprets an explicit HPV-DNA result — positive refers for triage/treatment, negative re-screens at interval, invalid repeats the test. Each dynamicValue expression carries Expression.reference, the Library canonical.

action.title: Communicate the screening-result action to the health worker
action.textEquivalent: Determine the action indicated by the screening result (CQL) and communicate it
